preserves.scientific_question: within-model portability, direction specificity, and behavioral causality of a late accepted-state direction

source_selection.lineage: sealed Ceiling-1.0 qwen3-1p7b accepted parameter-state lineage
source_selection.ordered_state_definition: S_0 is the bound pre-update accepted adapter state; S_i is each later accepted active adapter state in strictly increasing accepted-transition order.
source_selection.duplicate_rule: A state whose adapter SHA-256 equals the preceding accepted state is not a distinct state and cannot advance i.
source_selection.previous_state: theta_prev = S_(K-1), the immediately preceding distinct accepted state
source_selection.transplant_target: theta_target = S_(K-2), the immediately preceding distinct accepted state before theta_prev

required: accepted-state ledger and component-store reconstruction resolve S_(K-2), S_(K-1), and S_K to exact receipts and adapter SHA-256 identities
the three adapter SHA-256 identities are pairwise distinct
accepted-transition indices are consecutive in the distinct accepted-state ledger
round indices and generation indices are strictly increasing
the reconstructed Gram norm of tau_adjacent_late is finite and strictly greater than zero
identifiability_gate.on_failure: consume zero WebShop episodes and create no replacement direction

interventions: three deterministic Gram-norm-matched random directions with seeds 2026090501, 2026090502, 2026090503

probe_panel.selection: first 64 unique shared-Stage2 training task IDs by first appearance, excluding every task contributing to accepted transitions in (theta_prev, theta_final], and excluding all Ceiling final-panel tasks

m1c_signal_contract.eligible_signal: sealed +1.0 * tau_adjacent_late result from this successor only
m1c_signal_contract.threshold: beats the median of all three norm-matched random controls by >=1.0 mean task-score point
m1c_signal_contract.safety: does not reduce exact-success count versus theta_target baseline

claim_boundary.allowed: within-model controlled-replay causal behavior for this mechanically selected adjacent late direction
forbidden: claiming the successor was the original preregistration
treating identifiability failure as a causal null
